headline: Community forum on the Ends Policy update, revised financial policy, and adding a member to the Act 170 Merger Committee.
summary: The meeting includes a community forum and first reading on the Ends Policy. It also covers a revised financial policy, an action item to add a member to the Act 170 Merger Committee, and two staff hires.
items: Proposed executive session (closed to public) under 1 V.S.A. § 313(a) for employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Community forum: Ends Policy review (first reading)
Discussion: revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities (first reading)
Discussion: monthly financial reports to replace quarterly reports for 2.4 and 2.5; these reports will be presented annually in March
Action: appoint an additional member to the Act 170 Merger Committee. South Burlington must appoint 2 if Winooski appoints 1, or 3 if Winooski appoints 2
Consent agenda: hire Katherine Lafont, 1.0 FTE Special Educator at Orchard School, replacing Andrea Ustianov
Consent agenda: hire Rebecca Mellen, .40 FTE Math Teacher at South Burlington High School
Consent agenda: set agenda for September 2, 2026 regular meeting and review future agenda items
location: South Burlington School District, 577 Dorset Street
